_README: W3-D18-02a — the SAVE PROOF config. Guinea-pig A only.
A was extended to ~2026-12-01 by the live transaction in PR #105, so it will
NOT approach a threshold on its own. This raises the ACTION THRESHOLD above
A's remaining TTL so the engine genuinely detects it as due. Nothing about
A's TTL is faked and nothing is written to make this true.
NARRATE IT THAT WAY (W4-D28-01): 'we raised the alert threshold above its
remaining TTL so the engine would fire'. Implying natural decay on A would be
a false claim to a funder. The genuinely unattended decay is B, on Sep 21.
extendToLedgers is an ABSOLUTE TARGET remaining-TTL, not a delta, and it must
CLEAR the raised threshold — Rakha's correction in #120. A target of 518,400
under a 1,500,000 threshold would extend to a value still below its own alert
line, and the engine would re-propose it forever.
B and C stay in _doNotWatch. The write guard refuses them regardless.

defaults._note: Threshold raised above A's ~1,386,000 remaining so it reads as due. Target clears the threshold.

_doNotWatch._warning: GUINEA-PIG B — move into 'contracts' only via the verified procedure in docs/SETUP.md.
_doNotWatch._why: It is deliberately ageing so it EXPIRES ~2026-09-21 12:00 UTC (alert threshold ~2026-09-20). DECIDED 2026-09-14 (W3-D18-02b): the engine must NOT save it. This _why previously said the opposite — 'so the engine can save it unattended' — which contradicted the list it sits in and read as an instruction to move B into 'contracts'. Doing that destroys the only unrepeatable evidence in the sprint. Bumping it early destroys the grant's strongest evidence. Calibrated at bumpWhenRemainingLedgersBelow 17280, the engine declines to act until the crossing — so verify that threshold in dry-run before it ever runs live against B.
_doNotWatch.label: guinea-pig-B-natural-decay

_doNotWatch._warning: GUINEA-PIG C — the SPARE natural-decay proof. Same rule as B.
_doNotWatch._why: Deliberately ageing so it EXPIRES ~2026-09-26 12:00 UTC (alert threshold ~2026-09-25). It is the only second shot if B is missed, so an early bump costs the sprint its fallback as well as its primary. The write guard refuses it unconditionally regardless of this list; both exist so a misconfiguration and a code path have to fail together.
_doNotWatch.label: guinea-pig-C-natural-decay
